title: Classical Lean Formalization Candidates
purpose: Expose small useful Lean formalization candidates inspired by the historical mathematics transcription project, plus a side-paper SplitZero formalization lane. The motivation is library growth: Lean/mathlib needs more formal mathematics, and these are candidate additions.
namespace_note: Some Lean files use the legacy internal namespace prefix ClassicalAudit from the first experiment. This is only a code namespace and is not a public audit or certification claim.
